title: Bridges of Norway (Norske broer)
description: 115 named bridges in Norway curated from Wikidata (P31=Q12280 ∩ P17=Q20). Each record contains multilingual names (Norwegian Bokmål, Nynorsk, English, Swedish, Danish, German), Wikidata QID, coordinates (P625), administrative location (P131), bridge subtype (P31), waterway/road crossed (P177), operator/owner/architect, structural dimensions where available (length, width, height, span, clearance), inception and opening dates, Wikimedia Commons image URL, and Wikipedia sitelinks in seven languages. Sorted alphabetically by Norwegian name.
